pages.title: Parsing settings
pages.summary: The settings that decide how a document's source is read, as the registry was built with them.

keys.name: comments
keys.description: Whether comments are recognized at all. Default: `true`.
keys.summary: Whether comments are recognized at all. Default: `true`.

schema.description: Whether comments are recognized at all. Default: `true`.

keys.name: comment_prefix
keys.description:
What starts a comment. Default: `%%` (two characters, unlike LaTeX's
single `%`). An empty prefix recognizes no comment.

This setting also decides whether a lone `%` is a forbidden character:
see `FlmParsing::percent_forbidden`.

keys.name: dollar_math
keys.description:
Whether `$…$` and `$$…$$` delimit mathematics. Default: `false`, in which
case a `$` in the source is reported as
`DollarMathDisabled`. `\(…\)` and
`\[…\]` delimit mathematics either way.
